🔥 vulcan-launcher | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide Android users with a highly customizable and feature-rich home screen experience that prioritizes privacy and offline functionality.
✨ Key Features: • No internet access (completely offline) • No ads, trackers, or analytics • Nova Launcher-like features (icon packs, gestures, customization) • App drawer with search and organization • Customizable look and feel (icon shapes, themes)
📖 Summary: Vulcan is an Android home screen launcher designed with privacy and simplicity at its core. It offers a feature-rich experience similar to Nova Launcher but without any internet access, ads, trackers, or analytics, ensuring all data remains on the user's device.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ asimov-1 | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide the complete set of resources (design files, software, documentation) for individuals or organizations to build, simulate, and customize their own Asimov 1 humanoid robot.
✨ Key Features: • Open-source humanoid robot design • 1.2m height, 35kg weight, 25 actuated DOF • Includes mechanical CAD, electrical CAD, simulation model, and onboard software • Options for DIY kit or self-sourcing components
📖 Summary: Asimov 1 is an open-source, 1.2m tall, 35kg humanoid robot with 25 actuated degrees of freedom. This repository provides the necessary mechanical CAD, electrical CAD, simulation models, and onboard software for users to build, simulate, and customize their own Asimov 1 robot.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 aimori | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To prevent accidental leakage of sensitive personal or organizational data into AI chat interfaces by scanning and offering to modify prompts before submission.
✨ Key Features: • Local data scanning: Checks prompts for sensitive data directly in the browser. • Privacy-focused: No server, no account, no telemetry, and no network access. • Broad data type detection: Identifies over 200 types of sensitive data.
📖 Summary: AImori is an open-source browser extension designed to protect sensitive data when interacting with AI websites. It operates locally within the browser, scanning prompts for personal information like bank details, credit card numbers, and PII before they are sent to AI services, offering options to redact or rephrase the content.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 dsh-locale-ru | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a fully translated Russian user interface for the DeepSeek Harness application, making it more accessible to Russian-speaking users.
✨ Key Features: • Full Russian localization of DeepSeek Harness UI • Does not patch core application files (`app.asar`)
📖 Summary: This repository provides an unofficial Russian localization package for the DeepSeek Harness application. It translates the entire user interface into Russian without modifying core application files, ensuring compatibility with future updates. The package includes an easy-to-use .exe installer and manual installation options.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 chrome-crawler | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating complex web interactions, generating scripts for repetitive tasks, and creating 3D models directly within the Chrome browser using an AI agent.
✨ Key Features: • Web page interaction (reading, clicking, typing, scrolling) via Chrome DevTools Protocol • Support for both cloud and local LLM models • User confirmation for critical actions • Automated script generation for routine tasks
📖 Summary: Chrome Crawler is a JavaScript-based Chrome extension that acts as an AI agent within the browser's side panel. It can automate web interactions like reading pages, clicking, typing, and scrolling using the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It also supports generating scripts for routine tasks and creating 3D models via APIs.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 yahont-ce | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified, self-hosted knowledge base and enhanced AI capabilities for teams, enabling them to leverage their internal data and external tools through AI agents and contextual search.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted AI platform • Knowledge and context layer • Connects to applications and indexes data • Provides answers with source citations
📖 Summary: Yahont is a self-hosted AI platform that acts as a knowledge and context layer for teams and AI agents. It connects to various data sources, indexes information, and provides answers with source citations, while also enabling LLMs with advanced capabilities like web search and image generation.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 yahont-ce | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified, self-hosted knowledge base and enhanced AI capabilities for teams, enabling them to leverage their internal data and external tools through AI agents.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted AI platform • Knowledge and context layer • Connects to applications and indexes data from any source • Answers with links to source documents • Supports any LLM (local or cloud)
📖 Summary: Yahont is a self-hosted AI platform that acts as a knowledge and context layer for teams and AI agents. It connects to various data sources, indexes information, and provides answers with verifiable sources, while also enabling LLMs with advanced capabilities like web search and code execution.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
